BATF Group – Chemical Production Facility Project

TONGYANG was deeply involved in the BATF Group chemical production facility project, contributing to equipment manufacturing, engineering coordination, and project implementation support.

Our participation covered customized chemical equipment fabrication, technical coordination, manufacturing quality control, and equipment delivery support, helping meet the project's technical and operational requirements.

Project Highlights

  • Extensive involvement in chemical production facility development

  • Customized industrial equipment manufacturing

  • Engineering collaboration and technical coordination

  • Manufacturing quality assurance and inspection

  • Equipment delivery and project execution support

This project demonstrates TONGYANG's capabilities in supporting complex chemical manufacturing facilities through reliable equipment solutions and close collaboration with project stakeholders.
